definition: a long narrow passage inside a building
description: A long narrow passage inside a flat, white walls on both sides, coat racks with jackets hanging on each wall and two long rows of shoes on the floor. A woman carries a laundry basket down the passage towards the camera; two men squeeze past her carrying a big cardboard box over a bicycle parked in the passage; at the end the passage is empty again, with only the shoes and coats and a blue door at the far end.
